meta.title: How we work: from the first conversation to campus
meta.description: Six steps: free consultation, level assessment, subject strategy, online teaching, Pearson exams and university applications, visa and settling in.

header.title: Every student is a project of their own
header.lede: Six steps from the first conversation to campus. At each step you know in advance what happens, what we need from you and how long it takes.

items.title: Free consultation and goal analysis
items.body: An online conversation about the student's goal, current school and year, and the family's priorities. There is no charge.

details.label: What we need from you
details.text: Fill in the form and choose a convenient time.

items.title: English and academic level assessment
items.body: We assess the student's level and share the result in writing. It becomes clear which programme to start and at what pace.

items.title: Subject, country and course strategy
items.body: We set the target subject, country and a university shortlist (Safe / Target / Reach), and the A-Level combination to match. You receive an offer and a written contract at this step.

details.label: What we need from you
details.text: Discuss the shortlist and subjects as a family, and read the contract.

details.label: What you get
details.text: University shortlist, subject plan, offer and contract.

items.title: Online teaching and weekly monitoring
items.body: Live lessons, mentoring by professors, mock exams and a weekly report for parents.

details.label: What we need from you
details.text: Attend lessons, do the homework and study independently.

items.title: Pearson exams and university applications
items.body: Exam registration and follow-up. Personal statement, references, UCAS / Common App / European applications and scholarship research.

details.label: What we need from you
details.text: Provide documents on time and work with us on your personal statement.

details.label: What you get
details.text: Exam registration confirmation and submitted applications.

items.title: From offer to arrival
items.body: Checking visa and financial documents, visa interview practice, halls or accommodation, travel and pre-arrival information.

details.label: What we need from you
details.text: Prepare your visa documents and take part in interview practice.

details.label: What you get
details.text: A complete visa file and a settling-in plan.

blocks.title: The exam process in five steps

items.title: Subject and unit codes are set
items.body: We choose the target exam series.

items.title: A suitable centre is chosen
items.body: We confirm that the centre accepts private candidates.

items.title: Registration
items.body: Registration is completed before the final deadline. The confirmation is checked.

items.title: Results and certificate
items.body: Following up results, planning resits if needed, and handing over the certificate.
